description: This file defines the EntityDeriver class, which implements ContainerDeriverInterface to provide derivative definitions for entity types and bundles in Drupal. It manages derivative configurations for entity plugins, including their labels, constraints, and class implementations.

classes.name: EntityDeriver
classes.description: Provides derivative definitions for entity types and bundles, implementing ContainerDeriverInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EntityDeriver with base plugin ID, entity type manager, and bundle info service.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of EntityDeriver using the service container and base plugin ID.

methods.name: getDerivativeDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves a specific derivative definition by ID, generating definitions if necessary.

methods.name: getDerivativeDefinitions
methods.description: Generates derivative definitions for all entity types and their bundles.
